TEXT:
Now then, compared to a few moments ago, hasn't 
it gotten a lot better?

Next up, time to comfort the person most affected 
by all this...

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Hey, Makabe-kun.

SPEAKER: SPK_MAKABE
TEXT:
What is it, Senpai... I'm useless at this point, please 
leave me alone...

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
[font_size=17]You know that Galge art book you wanted? I'll bring it over one day. 
[/font_size]
It's Kirino's but whatever.

SPEAKER: SPK_MAKABE
TEXT: [font_size=25]R-Really!? The one with all the sexy illust--[/font_size]

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
Keep it down! Just get back to whatever you were 
doing. I'll tell you more later.

Sena's looking this way. I'm trying to clear my 
"Sexual Harassment Senpai" title here.

SPEAKER: SPK_MAKABE
TEXT: Got it! I'll do my best!

SPEAKER: SPK_SENA
TEXT:
...Kousaka-senpai, what were you two talking about...? 
Makabe's acting weirdly energetic.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: It's a promise between men. Right, Makabe?

SPEAKER: SPK_MAKABE
TEXT: Yeah, that's right.

Well, we're men, this sorta thing will always get us 
excited.

Makabe plays a significant role in the game's 
creation, if he's always curled up being depressed, 
we would all be in a tight spot.

Still... to borrow that art book from Kirino, I wonder 
what should I say...

And so, the chaotic game development team 
settled down to something more orderly... But, this 
doesn't guarantee completion before the deadline.

With all the commotion, we've fallen further behind 
schedule. The days passed with impending danger, 
the deadline ruthlessly approaches.
Then, I unexpectedly witnessed such a scene.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: ...Huh?

SPEAKER: SPK_SENA
TEXT:
Ah, Kousaka-senpai, good work today. What's the 
matter? Why are you here so late?
That's what I should be saying.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
I realized I forgotten something after getting home, 
so I came back to get it.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: What about you? Weren't you heading home?

SPEAKER: SPK_SENA
TEXT:
Well, given our progress so far, I don't think we'll 
make it in time for the cultural festival.

SPEAKER: SPK_SENA
TEXT:
I thought I could wrap up some of the work I'm 
able to do alone, so I came back.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
I see... The lights were still on in the club room, so I 
thought the president or the others would be here 
playing.

SPEAKER: SPK_SENA
TEXT: Too bad, it was Sena-chan.

Her hands still moving, she continued to work as we 
talked.

SPEAKER: SPK_SENA
TEXT:
I've been doing this for a few days, and I think our 
progress has been getting better.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
Huh? You mean it's not just today, you've done this 
plenty of times already?

SPEAKER: SPK_SENA
TEXT:
Yes. If Onii-chan finds me he goes, "Where are you 
going so late at night?" and makes a fuss, so I 
sneak out...

That means no one else in the club knows about 
this either.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: ...Must be hard, working all by yourself.

SPEAKER: SPK_SENA
TEXT:
Yeah... Without Gokou next to me, I get crazy with 
my imagination and the pictures get a bit too wild, 
bad stuff like that happen.

SPEAKER: SPK_SENA
TEXT:
But without everyone else around, my delusions 
don't go wild as often, so it's about the same.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: ...You're amazing.

SPEAKER: SPK_SENA
TEXT: Huh? I-I am?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
Yeah. To make something you want, you're even 
willing to put in the extra time and effort. That's 
amazing.

SPEAKER: SPK_SENA
TEXT:
I-It's not something that impressive. My delusions 
are just so powerful that I have to put them into 
form! That's all.

SPEAKER: SPK_SENA
TEXT:
As a fujoshi, I guess it's my nature, my work, and 
my pride.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
I see... If it helps motivate you this much to create 
works, maybe being rotten isn't so bad.

SPEAKER: SPK_SENA
TEXT: R-Really?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
Yeah. I don't hate it. If it helps make progress, isn't 
it fine to be more honest about your interests?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: It's best to do what you truly want.

SPEAKER: SPK_SENA
TEXT: ...Yeah.

This was the first time Sena's hands stopped 
moving.

SPEAKER: SPK_SENA
TEXT: Um... Senpai.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Huh?

SPEAKER: SPK_SENA
TEXT: I'm... glad you're like that.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
Like what? Just so we're clear, I don't understand 
your interest one bit.

SPEAKER: SPK_SENA
TEXT: Um... not that... You approve of my interest, or rather...

SPEAKER: SPK_SENA
TEXT:
You're even fine with me carrying on with my 
interests...

SPEAKER: SPK_SENA
TEXT:
I can't really put it into words properly, but... It's fun 
when I'm with you.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: I-Is that right?

After saying that, she shifted her glance downward. 
It looked like she was getting a bit red.

It's just the two of us here... I mean, don't we have 
a good mood going on here...

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: I-Is there anything I can help with?

SPEAKER: SPK_SENA
TEXT:
O-Of course, there's a mountain of things you can 
do. Don't tell me you plan on staying as well, 
Senpai?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
...There's no way I can just head back and abandon 
my junior.

SPEAKER: SPK_SENA
TEXT: ...You're really nice.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Not really, I'm normal.

SPEAKER: SPK_SENA
TEXT: Is that kindness what caught Onii-chan's heart?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: That again?

I might be saying that, but that made me a bit 
happy.

Isn't this how we usually act when we're together? 
It's easier to work like this.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
Actually, I've brought over some stuff. Here, take 
whatever you like.

SPEAKER: SPK_SENA
TEXT: Ah, that pudding looks great. Is it really okay?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
Don't worry about it! It's just some stuff that I 
bought from the convenience store on my way 
here.

SPEAKER: SPK_SENA
TEXT: I'll gratefully accept it then!

SPEAKER: SPK_SENA
TEXT:
This is great...! It's totally delicious! You have a great 
eye for this stuff!

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
For real? It was just in the recommended area, so 
I just bought some.

SPEAKER: SPK_SENA
TEXT:
You mean you haven't had any? This won't do at all, 
you ought to have some! This flavor will surely 
become a precious memory in your youth!

That's just something from the convenience store 
though.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: No, it's fine. If it's good, then do enjoy it yourself.

SPEAKER: SPK_SENA
TEXT:
No! I want you to eat it as well so we can agree 
and both say "This is delicious!"

...Hey now, you've completely entered little sister 
mode.

SPEAKER: SPK_SENA
TEXT: Okay, open your mouth! Come on!

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Okay, okay.

I opened my mouth in anticipation, doing what I 
was told. Sena puts the spoon in my lips. The sweet 
flavor spreads throughout...

At this moment, I realized it. Whoa, isn't this reaction 
really similar to what couples experience?

SPEAKER: SPK_SENA
TEXT: It's good, right? Didn't I tell you it's good? Right?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Y-yeah... It really is great.

SPEAKER: SPK_SENA
TEXT:
Eh... Senpai, your reaction is too muted! Are you 
trying to act cool like a hard-boiled senpai?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
S-Shut up! We're getting back to work after this, 
alright?

SPEAKER: SPK_SENA
TEXT: I got it already~.

Honestly, I'm not sure about the flavor. But, there's 
one thing I do know.

This is fun. Hanging out and doing something 
together.

I decided, I'll drop by with another bunch of 
"supplies" next time. That is of course, if Sena is 
here.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
Well, at any rate, keep up the good work. Here, just 
treat these as supplies from a comrade-in-arms, you 
can have it all.

I handed the juice and snacks I bought at the 
convenience store over and decided to leave the 
club room.

SPEAKER: SPK_SENA
TEXT: Eh? Can I really have these?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
Yeah it's fine, I'll see you here tomorrow then, 
okay?

SPEAKER: SPK_SENA
TEXT: Yes! I'll be waiting.

Phew. Feels like it just gotten more awkward, so I 
ended up escaping.

I'm weak to pressure from these lovey-dovey 
situations... Since I'm not used to them.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Well, putting that aside, I've done all I can.

I contacted all the other members and gave them 
some words of encouragement.

I've been a bit soft in managing this project. I'd 
better look over and revise the schedule when I 
get back.

All I can do now is provide support for what she 
does.

After parting with Sena, I headed home alone... 
Then I remembered her words from earlier.

SPEAKER: SPK_SENA
TEXT: Um... not that... You approve of my interest, or rather...

SPEAKER: SPK_SENA
TEXT:
You're even fine with me carrying on with my 
interests...

SPEAKER: SPK_SENA
TEXT:
I can't really put it into words properly, but... It's fun 
when I'm with you.
...It's fun being with me, huh...

Clearly I was embarrassed, so I couldn't find out 
more but, was that... a confession?

I don't think it was on that level. Still, I was 
confident that we had a good thing going on...

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
Perhaps with just one more attempt, I might end 
up groping some breasts...
